title: "evoxc.core.TraceError"

<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Raised when a graph-building operation is used outside a valid trace.

Examples: calling an op function outside `evoxc.trace`/`@evoxc.defn`,
passing a concrete `~evoxc.core.Tensor` to an op function (no eager
mode), calling a `Defn` with concrete tensors, or using a
`SymbolicTensor` as a Python boolean / with unregistered operator
handlers.

[View Python source](https://github.com/EMI-Group/evoxc/blob/main/evoxc/core/errors.py#L31)
